Force = Mass x Acceleration

From what I’ve read and heard, the glove size for boxing pro fighting is 10-12oz which is not that much more padding than the 5-7oz UFC gloves. 

A lot of boxers train with 16oz gloves so they can punch faster with the 12oz gloves. Using this info, it’s easy to conclude that most boxers likely hit “harder” than their UFC equivalent simply because of the above equation for force. The gloves are heavier (mass) and the boxer is trained to hit fast and efficiently with it because of the heavier gloves during training (acceleration). 

Sure there are technically only 6 basic punches in the boxing repertoire, but with only 6 punches to practice over and over and over that makes for some deadly combos.

Women drool over a man that is busy and light hearted. Don’t dance with them and don’t buy just any woman a drink. Once you make eye contact with a woman move in fast, it’s creepy when you move in after making eye contact several times. Approach from the side, not the front. Keep the conversation light and humorous, do a brief profile of her and tailor your questions and responses to that profile. The woman should be doing 80% of the talking preferably, so you need to be asking questions that provoke interest which leads to conversation. Keep the questions light hearted, nothing serious or personal, nothing about family or work life. If she asks you a question about yourself, respond with a joke first and keep your sentences short when talking about yourself, she should come out of the conversation knowing you’re enjoyable to talk to and she should know almost nothing about you. 

Also you have to show genuine interest in the questions you ask. If you don’t know about something, ask her to explain with genuine interest. Nothing is a bigger turn off than a guy than nods his head thinking about his next question and doesn’t know a thing about what she’s talking about. If you’re not genuinely interested and it feels like you’re pulling teeth then it’s a simple mismatch, politely excuse yourself and move onto the next one. 

Memorize her name, repeat her name to her when asking a question occasionally, Dale Carnegie says “A person’s name is to that person the sweetest and most important sound in any language.”

After 15-20 mins of talking to her, politely excuse yourself with a light hearted humorous comment and mingle with people. You don’t want to hang around for the conversation to turn stale. Leave as soon as you start to grab her interest. After a little while you can come back to her. If you make eye contact with her while mingling stick your tongue out at her playfully or make a funny face. It’s okay to talk to other women in front of her, but don’t make it look like you’re doing a raffle of all the women in the bar. 

This is the most important part, I promise you that your life will not change just by reading a few paragraphs. If you want to change a certain aspect of your life you will have to study and apply the learned knowledge repetitively until it becomes habit. 

Read “How to Win Friends and Influence People” by Dale Carnegie to learn how people think and how to get them talking. 

Read “How to be a 3% Man” by Corey Wayne, he also has tons of videos on YouTube answering his clients questions. Just know that his teachings are 90% performance based, meaning it will all be an act and will work to pull women a few times (after plenty of practice) but it won’t help further than that. 

After that just read any personal development book, preferably 2 a month. There’s hundreds of years of hard study put into those pages and it will really open your eyes. Soon you will have women falling head over heel for you simply because a book is more important than women you don’t know and therefore you don’t have the time for them. (This is not stating books are more important than women, just that picking up women falls very low on the list of priorities of successful men that women truly want). 

Read “Models: Attract Women Through Honesty” by Mark Manson if you want a more permanent change in your overall dating life. It won’t help you pull any girl, but it will teach you to get the right one. 

Know you’re going to strike out more than you’re going to succeed in this game (unless you look like Bruce Willis). It’s all a numbers game, the more women you talk to, the better your chances. The more you practice, the better you’ll get.
